verdict.rationale: Logseq's local HTTP API server ships its own API documentation page and gives worked curl examples you can run against the local server. However, nothing shows that this reference is interactive, such as try-it-in-browser or explorer UI. The method reference is community-driven plugin docs, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive explorer or in-browser runnable examples, a first-party comprehensive method reference, an OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, a sandbox, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
